title: AgentAbstain: Do LLM Agents Know When Not to Act?
abstract: arXiv:2607.10059v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agent systems based on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for autonomous tasks, yet existing evaluations mostly focus on task success rather than whether agents know when to abstain. This gap poses real risks: under ambiguity, conflicting constraints, or tool failures, agents may execute unintended and irreversible actions. To close this gap, we present the first systematic evaluation framework for agentic abstention: the calibrated ability of tool-using LLM agents to recognize when not to act. At its core, AgentAbstain is a paired-task benchmark built on an agent-native taxonomy of 8 abstention scenarios across pre-execution reasoning and runtime discovery. It contains 263 paired tasks across 42 executable sandbox environments, where each pair consists of a should-act task and a should-abstain variant produced through a controlled perturbation to the instruction, tool, or environment state. translated_title: AgentAbstain：大语言模型智能体知道何时不应行动吗？
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统正日益被部署用于自主任务，然而现有评估大多关注任务成功与否，而非智能体是否知道何时应当放弃行动。这一缺口带来了真实风险：在存在歧义、约束冲突或工具故障的情况下，智能体可能执行非预期且不可逆转的操作。为弥补这一缺口，我们提出了首个针对智能体放弃行动的系统化评估框架，即衡量使用工具的LLM智能体识别何时不应行动的校准能力。AgentAbstain的核心是一个成对任务基准，其建立在智能体原生的分类法之上，涵盖执行前推理和运行时发现两个阶段的8种放弃行动场景。该基准包含跨42个可执行沙盒环境的263个成对任务，其中每一对任务由一个“应当行动”任务和一个通过对指令、工具或环境状态施加受控扰动而生成的“应当放弃”变体组成。
tldr: 本文提出AgentAbstain——首个系统评估工具使用型LLM智能体“何时不应行动”（放弃行动）能力的成对任务基准，包含跨42个可执行沙盒环境的263个成对任务，覆盖执行前与运行时8种放弃场景。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AgentAbstain, the first systematic paired-task benchmark evaluating when tool-using LLM agents should abstain from acting, comprising 263 paired tasks across 42 executable sandbox environments spanning 8 abstention scenarios in both pre-execution reasoning and runtime discovery.
